test_title: PYST 37: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All plants are herbs.

Some herbs are trees.

All trees are shrubs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some shrubs are plants.

II. Some shrubs are herbs.

III. Some trees are plants.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Here, we are given some statements and from that we need to find out if the given conclusions are true or not.

So, from 1st statement: All plants are herbs, we get the figure: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b18f7937a34804b3ea34940a5f1146e870b9a7d998b1abe5d8d4bd7676ca605.png] 

Also, from 2nd statement: Some herbs are trees, we get the figure: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faf22b7c7bc3f77da467aab6ea3dec9fac4d8e5ea7d75077db99f800ca30280b.png] 

And, from 3rd statement: All trees are shrubs, we get the figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c17f4b94aed59a3e906c9a4f229bd4d02b087a61eeb8b016b19e8bd0f2758231.png] 

Thus, combining all the three statements, we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bca329ec0295484050d807ddae8393bfc6a03b0c293bf8daf37ce9b9d7485a2.png] 

Next, we will check the conclusion from the given figure

I. Some shrubs are plants: This is not possible.

II. Some shrubs are herbs: This is true as we can see that some herbs are trees and all trees are shrubs. So this is true conclusion.

III. Some trees are plants: All plants are herbs and some herbs are trees. So, some trees cannot be plants and thus this is not true conclusion. 

Hence, only __**conclusion 2**__ is true.
